method: Built-in image generation; final production artwork vectorized from the approved original concept
originalPrompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished logo exploration review board for "ShiftBox", an open-source cloud development environment for ready-to-code developer workspaces. Direction 2: COMMAND SPACE. Design an original compact terminal-inspired symbol: opposing code-like corner forms enclosing an elegant forward prompt arrow, together reading as an open workspace/box. It must be a cohesive distinctive brand symbol, not a generic terminal window. Visually simple with strong silhouette and balanced thick strokes, usable at favicon size. Pair with exact wordmark "ShiftBox" in a refined slightly technical sans-serif, with subtle custom letter details. Flat vector-like graphic design, crisp edges. Choose a restrained professional accent color with dark wordmark. White or very light neutral board. Large primary horizontal logo centered in upper two thirds; small black monochrome version and standalone symbol neatly aligned along bottom. Tiny discreet caption "02 / COMMAND SPACE" at upper left. Editorial spacing, generous margins. No slogans, clouds, gradients, shadows, 3D objects, mockup merchandise, or other brands. This is a concept review image, not an application screen.
preparationPrompt: Prepare the approved primary ShiftBox COMMAND SPACE logo from the provided image as a clean production master. Edit target: reference image, specifically its large central purple symbol + ShiftBox wordmark. Preserve EXACTLY that logo design, letterforms, spacing, proportions and terminal-prompt arrow. Remove the board, captions, bottom examples and all background. One horizontal logo only, tightly framed with modest transparent margins. Solid flat violet #4834F5 symbol, solid near-black #191821 wordmark, absolutely no gradients, texture, shadows, lighting or effects. Crisp uniform fills and precise smooth outlines, suitable for later vector tracing. Transparent background. Do not redesign or change the icon. Exact text: ShiftBox. Keep the opposing rounded corner brackets, the diagonal openings, and the central right-pointing prompt chevron. Output a large high resolution wide image.
productionNotes: The preparation output was not used as the vector source. Original primary logo traced with Potrace 2.1.8, threshold 128, optTolerance 0.35, turdSize 8; shape extraction brightness threshold 150. Exported artwork uses flat fills and even-odd paths.
